scope: The restored Baron Empain Palace exterior in Heliopolis in late 2024, with the tall sculpted tower, lower dome, terraced two-storey body, verandas, corner pinnacles and entrance stairs.

originalReview.notes: The garden elevation shows the restored ochre and terracotta surfaces, tall sculpted tower and finial, lower dome, arcaded galleries and stepped terrace crowns.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact CC0 original published by Qualla shows the restored palace. The other article image depicts the separate Sultana Malak Palace and is excluded.
